an3.148:1.1: sagge. Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato . . . pe . . . visamena kāyakammena, visamena vacīkammena, visamena manokammena. Imehi kho bhikkhave . . . pe . . . evaṃ niraye.
